description: Equipment (packages/core/docs/mechanic-predicates.md §8): what may be equipped, into which slot, what it weighs and what it protects. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/prolog/mechanics/equipment-predicates.ts verbatim, including the pack-local equipment_sum/2 — the shared engine has findall/3 and length/2 but NOT aggregate_all/3, which lives in library(aggregate) and a pack may not depend on a library. carried_weight/2 and armor_value/2 are rules, never stored facts: a stored total goes stale against has_item/3 the moment anything is picked up. US-2 of 124-items-equipment-economy added the TRADE cases: who sells what, whether a shelf is bare, who the proceeds belong to, and whether a purse covers a price. What they deliberately do not pin is a PRICE — there is no price predicate and no price rule, because a stored price goes stale the moment a shelf moves (§12) and the arithmetic could not live in a pack that may not call helper-predicates.ts's reputation/3; conformance/items/ pins the arithmetic instead. US-3 added the PLACEMENT cases, which pin the story's one minted predicate — item_at/3, the fourth place an item can be and the only one the vocabulary had no fact for — plus the two rules over it: something lying where you are standing, and a container within reach. What they do not pin is a loot table, which is authored content core computes over (§11) rather than a fact.

cases.name: equips-what-the-actor-holds-has-room-for-and-has-the-skill-for
kb: equipped(Actor, Item, Slot) :- has_equipped(Actor, Slot, Item).
equipment_sum([X | T], S) :- equipment_sum(T, S0), S is S0 + X.
slot_free(A, Slot) :- equip_slot_capacity(Slot, N), findall(I, has_equipped(A, Slot, I), Equipped), length(Equipped, Used), Used < N.
can_equip(A, I) :- has_item(A, I, _), equip_slot(I, Slot), slot_free(A, Slot), \+ (item_requires(I, S, Min), \+ (has_skill(A, S, L), L >= Min)).
carried_weight(A, W) :- findall(Wi, (has_item(A, I, Q), item_weight(I, U), Wi is U * Q), Weights), equipment_sum(Weights, W).
encumbered(A) :- carried_weight(A, W), carry_capacity(A, Max), W > Max.
armor_value(A, V) :- findall(Av, (has_equipped(A, _, I), item_armor(I, Av)), Values), equipment_sum(Values, V).
stock_level(V, I, Q) :- container_contains(V, I, Q), !.
in_stock(V, I, Q) :- vendor(V, _), stock_level(V, I, Q), Q > 0.
scarce(V, I) :- vendor(V, _), item_stock_normal(I, N), stock_level(V, I, Q), Q < N.
proceeds_to(V, Owner) :- vendor(V, B), business_owner(B, Owner), !.
can_pay(A, Amount) :- gold(A, G), G >= Amount.
item_here(A, I) :- at_location(A, L), item_at(I, L, _).
container_here(A, C) :- at_location(A, L), container(C), at_location(C, L).
